say:2:1041574001:1.text: I was rereading the "Compendium of Practical Magic" and I came across something quite curious that Magister Merlin once wrote.
say:2:1041574001:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷先生，我最近重读《实用魔法集录》时，发现梅林大...
say:2:1041574001:1.male: I was rereading the "Compendium of Practical Magic" and I came across something quite curious that Magister Merlin once wrote.
say:2:1041574001:1.female: I was rereading the "Compendium of Practical Magic" and I came across something quite curious that Magister Merlin once wrote.

say:3:1041574002:1.text: He said the oldest restoration spells work on statues because the stone itself still holds the memory of loyalty.
say:3:1041574002:1.male: He said the oldest restoration spells work on statues because the stone itself still holds the memory of loyalty.
say:3:1041574002:1.female: She said the oldest restoration spells work on statues because the stone itself still holds the memory of loyalty.

say:4:1041574003:1.text: But if the caster's mind isn't pure, then the spell won't succeed at all!
say:4:1041574003:1.source_cn: 若施法者心怀杂念，魔法便会失效！

say:6:1041574005:1.text: Though if memory serves, Merlin never paused to consider whether the statue wanted to wake.
say:6:1041574005:1.source_cn: 不过据我所知，梅林当年使用修复术时，可没考虑过石像是否...
say:6:1041574005:1.male: Though if memory serves, Merlin never paused to consider whether the statue wanted to wake.
say:6:1041574005:1.female: Though if memory serves, Merlin never paused to consider whether the statue wanted to wake.

say:7:1041574006:1.text: Some things... crack when forced back into shape, don't you think?
say:7:1041574006:1.source_cn: 毕竟，有些沉睡之物，强行复原反而会开裂……你说呢？

say:8:1041574007:1.text: Merlin also wrote that a mage's duty isn't to hide the cracks, it's to let the light through them.
say:8:1041574007:1.source_cn: 梅林大人还写过，魔法师的职责不是掩盖裂痕，而是让光透进去。
say:8:1041574007:1.male: Merlin also wrote that a mage's duty isn't to hide the cracks, it's to let the light through them.
say:8:1041574007:1.female: Merlin also wrote that a mage's duty isn't to hide the cracks, it's to let the light through them.

say:9:1041574008:1.text: Like the Light Refraction Spell on page 360, it reveals what lurks in shadow.
say:9:1041574008:1.source_cn: 比如书中第三百六十页的光折射术，能轻松照出阴影中的伪饰！

say:10:1041574009:1.text: Since when did you become fond of metaphors? You hardly seem like the Cassadee I remember. (Chuckle)
say:10:1041574009:1.source_cn: 你何时都学会隐喻了？这可不是我印象中的科丝蒂，呵呵。

say:11:1041574010:1.text: But knowledge, when misplaced, can be a cage.
say:11:1041574010:1.source_cn: 但你可知道，知识若错落于人，反而会成为牢笼？

say:12:1041574011:1.text: A beautiful cage... like the court.
say:12:1041574011:1.source_cn: 比如……宫廷这座华丽的笼子。

say:13:1041574012:1.text: I... I think whether it's a cage depends on the one inside it.
say:13:1041574012:1.source_cn: 嗯……我想，牢笼与否，取决于笼中人的选择。

say:14:1041574013:1.text: When Magister Merlin refused the royal court's invitation, perhaps he saw that gilded bars sometimes hide sharp thorns.
say:14:1041574013:1.source_cn: 梅林大人当初拒绝耀光王室的邀请，或许正是看清了这个笼子...
say:14:1041574013:1.male: When Magister Merlin refused the royal court's invitation, perhaps he saw that gilded bars sometimes hide sharp thorns.
say:14:1041574013:1.female: When Magister Merlin refused the royal court's invitation, perhaps she saw that gilded bars sometimes hide sharp thorns.

say:15:1041574014:1.text: Impressive... quite the leap, Miss Cassadee. I might need to adjust my estimate of you.
say:15:1041574014:1.source_cn: 出色的联想力，科丝蒂小姐，或许我应当对你刮目相看了。

say:16:1041574015:1.text: But let me warn you—Merlin's supposed disdain for fame may only mean the price was never right.
say:16:1041574015:1.source_cn: 不过，容我提醒——梅林当年所谓的不慕名利，或许只是没等...
say:16:1041574015:1.male: But let me warn you—Merlin's supposed disdain for fame may only mean the price was never right.
say:16:1041574015:1.female: But let me warn you—Merlin's supposed disdain for fame may only mean the price was never right.

say:17:1041574016:1.text: And the court's thorns... they favor those bold enough to reach for them. I'm most curious to see how you handle them.
say:17:1041574016:1.source_cn: 而宫廷的荆棘……向来偏爱扎伤伸手之人。我真的很期待见到...

say:18:1041574017:1.text: If you ever find yourself in trouble, do come to me. Guiding newcomers is, after all, part of a Chief Court Mage's duty.
say:18:1041574017:1.source_cn: 届时，若你有任何困难，欢迎向我求助。毕竟，身为首席宫廷...

say:19:1041574018:1.text: Magister Cyran, I think I can break those thorns myself.
say:19:1041574018:1.source_cn: 迪尔格雷先生，我会靠自己折断那些荆棘的。

say:20:1041574019:1.text: And if there's truly a problem I can't solve... Magister Merlin will help far more than you ever could.
say:20:1041574019:1.source_cn: 如果真的有难以解决的问题，求助梅林大人，一定比求助你更管用。
say:20:1041574019:1.male: And if there's truly a problem I can't solve... Magister Merlin will help far more than you ever could.
say:20:1041574019:1.female: And if there's truly a problem I can't solve... Magister Merlin will help far more than you ever could.

say:22:1041574021:1.text: He has no hand in the affairs of the court... not like I do.
say:22:1041574021:1.male: He has no hand in the affairs of the court... not like I do.
say:22:1041574021:1.female: She has no hand in the affairs of the court... not like I do.
